image_description: A close-up, slightly high-angle shot of a printed restaurant menu lying on a table. The menu features a large, glossy photograph of a stir-fried dish (likely chicken or tofu with vegetables) in the center. Below the image, there are columns of text listing item names and prices in both Thai and English. A silver knife is visible at the top edge of the frame, resting on the table surface above the menu. To the left, a small portion of a red condiment container is visible. The lighting creates a glare on the glossy menu surface.

artifact_observations.location: Bottom half of the menu, specifically the text columns.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text attempts to mimic Thai and English scripts but fails completely at character formation. Letters are melted, fused, or invented. This is a classic AI generation failure mode for text-heavy objects.

artifact_observations.location: The food image on the menu.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The food has a 'waxy' or 'plastic' sheen that doesn't quite match realistic oil/gloss. Edges of the vegetables blend slightly into the sauce/background in an unnatural way.

artifact_observations.location: The knife handle at the top.
artifact_observations.reasoning: The knife handle appears to merge indistinctly with the background/table. The geometry of the handle end is vague and lacks sharp definition.
The left edge of the paper seems to warp slightly rather than maintaining a straight geometric line, though this could be minor lens distortion.
